Hi Caroline —

Thanks for the spreadsheet — can confirm we can support a short-term BYOK flow but there are a few clarifying points before I give a hard yes: 
1) BYOK model: do you require key material to remain solely in your KMS (customer-managed HSM) or is a short-lived escrow acceptable (Redwood-hosted ephemeral wrapping for the 7-day window)? Escrow would reduce operational friction but we need explicit approval.
2) Audit log granularity: you asked for per-request SSO identity and key usage. We can include per-token IDs and key IDs, but we need to align on the log schema so our evidence package matches your ingestion.
3) Signed evidence: we can produce a timestamped package (SHA256 manifest + signed statement) after the window; legal will want a brief SOW addendum.

Next steps I propose: internal triage with product + infra today, then a short call with your security lead to align on the schema and signature expectations. Grace, Ben, Aisha — copying you for feasibility + rough ETA.

Caroline/procurement — are you available for a 30-minute call today or tomorrow morning? If not, we can run an accelerated asynchronous plan.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
